data.text: Permanent. Stat buy (channeling). Perform summoning a creature until the sum of your Stats spent can be rounded to 24. The creature always follows you and stays onto your tile. Water golem stats 10/9/5/0. 2 hits, 2 actions.

logic.description: Implemented stat buy (channeling). Summons the Water golem (V/W/M/Wi 10/9/5/0, 2 hits, 2 actions) that follows the caster and stays on its tile; the need is the unified Σ 24 (stat_buy_total). Every emission banks the caster stat behind the element going out (card elements round-robin) until the bank is at least the need (24); no dice, so nothing fails — a low stat only takes longer. The creature appears as the caster ally on completion and the card stays as a permanent with FIXED power 6 (Rule 24: the destroyer needs a 6); on destruction the creature vanishes and its card goes to the owner archive. Elements Souls (World) then Harmony (Will) alternate. No ∀ bonus on the card (a double cast is just a longer chain).

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).

effects.description: Every emission banks the caster stat behind the element going out (card elements round-robin: emission k banks element k mod |elements|); no dice, nothing fails.
The cast completes once the bank is at least the need (stat_buy_total 24).
Upper bound of emissions at the caster current stats: need ÷ the smallest stat the card elements bank, rounded up (the k/n cast length shown in the UI).
Stat-buy summons are always cast with tokens of value 6 (fixed power, no die rolled at placement).
Rule 24 with fixed power: the destroyer needs a 6. On destruction the creature vanishes and its card goes to the owner archive.
